title: Get Griddy
blurb: The dance escaped the internet, reached professional sport, and then came back again. Fortnite's Get Griddy emote packaged an already-viral routine into a purchasable celebration, and the audio has since become the standard signal that somebody is about to celebrate — appropriately or otherwise. It has turned up in end zones, school corridors, wedding receptions and at least one graduation stage. Play it whenever a celebration is imminent, deserved or not. The dance itself is technically optional, though the button press does rather commit you.
origin: The music from Fortnite's Get Griddy emote, based on the viral dance.
